name: Necklace of Fireballs
description: A string of small glowing orange beads.
body:
## What it does

As an action, pull off a bead and throw it up to 60 feet, and it bursts as a fireball. Throw several at once and the fireball grows by a level for each bead past the first. It holds 1d6 + 3 beads when found, and they do not grow back.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.note: each further bead thrown with it raises its level by one

charges.last: the necklace is only a string
